summary: M6_2R_CODER_PLAN (CODER, plan_only). Produced 04-artifacts/impl/M6.2R/PLAN.md -- a minimal, mapped, rollback-per-item plan (NO code) for the recall-risk mapper: take an ops-core /v1/availability/check response (a value object / dict, NOT a live HTTP call) and produce the three ops-core-sourced risk_flags (recall, sale_lock, quality_hold) that feed the EXISTING M6.2Q Scale Gate, STAGED (mock response in tests; the live HTTP client is the S1b seam / go-live 2026-09-11), cumulative superset of M6.2Q. PRECONDITION verified: ledger M6-P2601=RUNNING (row 251), dependency M6-P2600=SIGNED (entry gate PASS); IMPLEMENTATION_TARGET_LOCKED status=LOCKED, live_migrations=false, M6-OD-011 DECIDED. OWNER AUTHORIZATION (from the M6-P2600 entry gate + M6-OD-017): pull-path mapper, recall = recall_hold OR recall_case_open / sale_lock / quality_hold, read presence BOOLEANS only (never decision/block_reasons), any presence-flag true -> Scale-Gate Risk row FAIL even when decision==SELLABLE, pull error/timeout/429 -> INCOMPLETE -> fail-closed (RULE-017), FAIL gate only + no auto-pause, STAGED live-HTTP-out, no flag flip. Contract M6-CTR-026 resolved-for-entry (harmonization M6-P0709 PASS). THE PLAN (LEAN -- one new pure module + one regression; NO migration, NO gate-logic change, NO HTTP client, NO new secret): the new app/measurement/scale/recall_risk_mapper.py = a frozen value object OpsCoreAvailabilityResponse (presence booleans recall_hold/sale_lock/quality_hold + additive recall_case_open=False; decision/sku_ref RECORDED but NEVER read by the mapper; from_mapping dict path) + a RecallRiskRead result (risk_flags, complete, reason) + RECALL_RISK_KEYS (subset of conditions.RISK_LOCKS) + map_risk_flags(pull) (valid response -> {recall: recall_hold or recall_case_open, sale_lock, quality_hold}, complete=True; pull error/None/malformed -> risk_flags={}, complete=False, never a False false-clear, never a fabricated True) + map_pull_outcome (models the S1b seam's success/timeout/429/connection-error with NO HTTP) + recall_risk_contribution (merges the observed recall locks onto a caller base map; a partial contribution, never a standalone clearing map). LEG 1 = the E2 mapping (recall = recall_hold OR recall_case_open, additive, booleans-only, no fabricated lock). LEG 2 = rides the EXISTING gate (a present lock -> _risk FAIL + record_owner_decision REFUSED even when decision==SELLABLE) -- no gate code change. LEG 3 = fail-closed on pull error (empty ops-core map -> _risk HOLD + approval REFUSED, does not clear). Plus one CODER regression tests/test_m6_2r_recall_risk_mapper.py covering legs 1/2/3 + the partial-contribution safety. ADVERSARIAL RED-TEAM (ultracode, 3 agents: 2 finders prototyping the planned mapper against the running M6.2Q gate + an independent skeptic re-verifying): the spec-faithfulness/compat dimension was CLEAN; the fail-closed-vs-real-gate dimension found 1 MAJOR (CONFIRMED). THE MAJOR (a real design bug in my draft plan the review caught + I fixed): conditions._risk() returns PASS for ANY non-empty risk_flags with no active lock (it distinguishes empty->HOLD from non-empty, but does NOT require all 6 RISK_LOCKS present), so the mapper's normal clean read {recall:False, sale_lock:False, quality_hold:False} (a 3-of-6 subset) fed as the SOLE ScaleContext.risk_flags would read Risk=PASS at propose (while complaint_p0/platform_spam_flag/crm_suppression are UNOBSERVED) and _assert_risk_clear_at_approval's all-6 completeness test then falls back to that spurious PASS -> a false CLEAR (an owner APPROVE recorded on a 3-of-6 risk picture) -- the RULE-017 hole the re-check exists to prevent. My draft's fail-closed argument wrongly claimed the completeness re-check backstops a partial map; it backstops only the EMPTY map. Harmless in the staged posture (overall=HOLD via Funnel/Dashboard, is_scale_authorized stays False), but a live scale-authorization false-clear once M6-OD-002/005 ratify. FIX (in scope, no gate change): the mapper is redefined as a PARTIAL risk contributor -- used only in the FAIL direction (a present recall lock -> gate FAIL) and the incomplete/empty direction (pull error -> HOLD/refused); its clean 3-key output is NEVER presented as the sole clearing ScaleContext.risk_flags; a clearing decision requires the full 6-lock map (all sources merged, out of this slice's scope). The false backstop claim is removed (S0 red-team bullet + item (f) rewritten to recall_risk_contribution as a merge); the regression adds a partial-contribution safety assertion (clean keys are a STRICT subset of RISK_LOCKS; the contribution leaves the other 3 locks absent); and the gate's _risk partial-at-propose false-clear is surfaced as a FORWARD gate-hardening finding for the owner (S4) -- a pre-existing gate limitation NOT introduced by M6.2R and, per the slice's no-gate-change scope (M6-OD-017), NOT fixed here (owner action recommended: require all 6 RISK_LOCKS present for _risk PASS, or merge all sources before any clearing context; flagged per RULE-018). SCOPE: the mapper + fail-closed-on-error + the ScaleContext.risk_flags wiring (no gate-logic change). Out of scope = the live HTTP client (S1b seam / go-live 2026-09-11), the campaign->SKU join (separate data-source decision), the M3-side block_reason vocabulary / decision gating + pause SLA (M3/owner own); no flag flip. Boundary intact: M6 consumes ops-core booleans FOR ITS OWN gate; it does not own the recall decision, pause a campaign, send CRM, change M3 gating, or compute a commission (RULE-018/019); the response carries campaign/SKU refs (not PII); no raw PII, no secret. No migration (migrations stay 0001-0016). M6-P1000/M6-P1309 stay BLOCKED. Forward conditions (recorded, NOT blockers): M6-OD-002 (thresholds) OPEN + S1b live-HTTP + campaign-join + M3 block_reason/pause-SLA + M6-OD-011 server-bind/go-live remain hard gates before any live recall pull / real scale / egress. No self-certification; the runner gate + JUDGE (M6-P2609) decide.
